title: Continuity, Dependency, Stale-Reference & Update Diagnostics
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic continuity, dependency, stale-reference and update diagnostics over MAS-01..17 while preserving canonical owner truth and keeping diagnostics, remediation proposals and update analysis distinct from canonical mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent deterministic Adventure continuity/dependency diagnostics and stale-reference/update analysis without silently rewriting canonical owner data or applying updates merely because a diagnostic exists.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically diagnose continuity, dependency and stale-reference/update conditions over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner references and fail-closed invalid states while keeping diagnostics and remediation proposals non-mutating until canonical owners authorize change.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-17 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

MAS-18 consumed explicit MAS-17 prepared references plus validated predecessor owner bindings; invalid/mismatched owner bindings and dangling diagnostic subjects fail closed while a missing expected dependency is reported without being silently manufactured.

Continuity findings do not rewrite predecessor references; dependency findings do not create or repair missing dependencies; stale-reference findings do not refresh owner data; update-impact findings do not apply updates, migrations or remediation.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN c3496edadf356708aa4294351de8de5371bfaf95; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-18.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-18, including current MSLR/MSWI planning; MAS-18 completion unlocks no new cross-program rotation, so MAS-19 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-20+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-18 is closed. MAS-19 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
